title: Stringfield's investigations into crash retrievals

tellings.quote: there's a guy named string Feld who did a huge uh you know number of Investigations into it

plain: A man named Stringfield is said to have done a huge number of investigations into crash retrievals, meaning the alleged recovery of crashed unknown craft by the US government. The journalist Michael Shellenberger mentions him in passing during an episode about a secret UFO program. He brings it up as an example of earlier digging into this kind of story.
